limitations: Requests are native GET reads, two reviewed fixture-preview POST operations, and private sign-in/exact-session sign-out POSTs.
Only native default views are visited. The two reviewed fixture-preview POSTs render samples only; no filter, fault, payment, provider, hardware or business mutation is dispatched.

This checks default-view responses and rendering, not every filter, total, workflow or possible data state. Identities, identifiers, contacts, codes and private media are masked in partial-viewport screenshots.
Native read endpoints may create their ordinary read-audit entries. No business mutation request is dispatched.

Preview-only instrumentation clones each original fetch Response before returning that same unconsumed Response. It records bounded PNG bytes as hashes/lengths only, and adds a bounded clone-read wait. Native responses and application data are not replaced.

Every preview must still satisfy the original strict observer PNG guard and match its bound successful clone by request-body hash, target-path hash, byte length and PNG hash. This is audit instrumentation, not a product fix or a root-cause finding.

Declared supported JSON schemas are checked using existing Fastify Ajv dependencies. Unsupported or missing schemas are explicit limitations, never reported as matches. This helper does not certify every workflow or asset-byte closure.
